rules_applied: Very bright galaxies (FLUX > 10000) at z < 0.01 → KNOWN_TYPE (nearby bright galaxy)
Stars at z ≈ 0 with unusual flux ratios → KNOWN_TYPE (unusual stellar type)
Objects with ZWARN > 0 and zero flux → ARTIFACT
Galaxies at z > 1 with extreme color (FLUX_G >> FLUX_R or vice versa) → INTERESTING
QSOs at z > 5 → NEEDS_SPECTRUM (extremely rare if real)
QSOs at z > 3 with ZWARN=0 → INTERESTING (confirmed high-z QSOs)
